direction.name: The quiet instrument
direction.idea: Radical understatement. Where every competitor shouts, this page almost whispers: a headline barely larger than body text, a narrow column, small exact demonstrations, and a great deal of untouched space. The restraint is the claim. It says the thing is simple, finished and sure of itself. This only works when it is carried through completely; one loud element breaks it. In the study, a tool for simple lists sold itself with a 27px headline and 12–14px copy and was one of the most confident pages in the set.
direction.composition: A single column 440–560px wide, placed left of centre (starting at about 22% of the viewport width) or dead centre, running the whole page. The headline is the one large thing on the first screen: two lines at display size (5–7vw), medium weight, starting on the column's left edge and allowed to run wider than the column. The supporting paragraph follows at body size (17–19px) in the full ink. One small primary button and one text link. Below, each point is a short paragraph followed by a compact demonstration or image no wider than the column. Sections are separated only by space (96–140px). Nothing spans the full width until the footer, which is a single quiet line. The first screen is mostly empty and that emptiness is composed: the column's top edge sits at about 30% of the viewport height.
direction.typography: One family, two weights. A display size for the headline (5–7vw), one heading size for section titles (about 32–40px), body at 17–19px, a small size for captions (14–15px). Leading 1.5 for text. Letter-spacing near zero. The typeface must be handsome at small sizes.
direction.colour: Paper and two inks (full and soft). One accent used on exactly one element per screen.
direction.imagery: Precise rather than loud: cropped interface details at true size, and real photographs of the customer's world held to the column width, each doing one job. One short looping clip can sit at column width too. Never a large stock hero image.
direction.richness: Precision. With so little on the page, alignment, spacing and the exact size relationships are the design. Every element shares the column's left edge.
direction.pitfalls: This is the one direction where a small headline is right; the inspector will not object, but do not mix it with a large display line. Emptiness must look decided: keep the column edges exact and the vertical rhythm even. Not suitable when the subject needs emotion or photography to sell. Quiet is not thin: the column must still deliver every piece of content the brief asks for, in full, at 16px or more in the full ink. In blind tests the quiet version lost every time it was quiet everywhere: a small headline beside an empty panel read as unfinished. Quiet means few things, not small things: the headline and the demonstration are large, and every screen holds content.

hero.name: Column on one line
hero.blueprint: A warm off-white page that is more than 80% empty. Everything hangs on one vertical alignment 27% in from the left edge, the start of column 4; nothing is centred and nothing sits to its left. A small logo mark sits on that alignment 56px from the top. About 220px lower the column begins, only 380px wide: a two-line headline at 27px in medium weight, line-height 1.25; one supporting sentence at 15px in the softer ink, line-height 1.5; then, 28px below, the single action as a near-black rectangular button with 4px corners and one text link with an arrow beside it. A sign-in text link sits alone in the top-right corner at 14px; there is no navigation bar. At the bottom edge the first demonstration peeks in on the same alignment: a flat panel one step darker than the page, 368px wide, its top 90px visible, holding two real rows of the product's interface at true size with a visible pointer. Mark the panel's root with data-ui. The right half of the screen is blank on purpose, and nothing spans the full width until the footer.
hero.mobile: The alignment becomes the 24px left margin. The logo mark sits 32px from the top and the column starts at 30% of the height: headline at 24px on two lines, the sentence at 15px, then button and text link side by side. The demonstration panel spans the width between the margins and shows its top 120px above the fold. The sign-in link stays top-right.
hero.headline: A dry two-line statement at 27px, up to about 30 characters per line; it never grows larger at any width.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Panel with margin notes
sections.blueprint: One tall panel from the product is shown whole, like a plate in a manual, with notes in both margins. The panel (an inspector, a sidebar, a composer) is built at true size, 360–400px wide and 640–720px tall, root marked data-ui, and stands in columns 5–8 on the plain ground with no stage behind it. Six notes describe six of its parts: three in columns 1–4, right-aligned, and three in columns 9–12, left-aligned, each 24ch wide and placed by absolute top offsets so its first line is level with the control it explains. A note is a name at 18px medium and two lines at 15px in the soft ink. Hovering or focusing a note keeps its control at full strength and drops the rest of the panel to 30% opacity; the controls themselves also work. The heading, two to four words at 32–40px, sits right-aligned in columns 1–4, level with the panel's top edge.
sections.mobile: The panel is shown in three slices, top, middle and bottom, each at true size and centred, cut where the next begins. Under each slice its two notes sit side by side in two columns at 15px. 56px between slices. The heading leads at 26px on the left margin.

sections.name: Pinned fragment, changing state
sections.blueprint: Two columns. Right, columns 7–12: a stage that is position: sticky; top: 14vh, holding one fragment of the real interface at true size on a single flat stage colour, about 520px square. Left, columns 1–5: three statements, each in its own block 80vh tall, so one is in view at a time. A statement is a two-line sentence at 28–32px that begins with its order word ('Paste a link.', 'Then pick the parts you want.', 'Share it when it looks right.') plus one supporting line at 16px. The statement nearest the viewport's centre is in full ink; the others sit at 30%. As each statement becomes active the fragment changes to the matching state: an empty field, a filled list with two rows selected, a finished result with its confirmation. Build the states in HTML and switch a class; do not swap screenshots. The heading, two to four words at 24–28px, sits above the first statement.
sections.mobile: The stage is sticky at the top, 46svh tall, the fragment fitted by cropping to its active region, not by shrinking its text. Statements scroll beneath it in blocks 60svh tall at 22px. The stage releases after the third statement.

sections.name: Lit panel, dark row
sections.blueprint: One dark field, 96svh tall. Across its middle runs a horizontal row of five to seven interface panels, each a different true-size fragment marked data-ui (an open menu, an inspector, a composer, a chart card), 320–460px wide at their natural heights, vertically centred and 26vw apart. The row scrolls sideways with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and scroll-snap-align: center, and can be dragged. Only the panel at the centre is lit: full opacity, in the product's light theme, the brightest thing on screen. The others sit at 22% opacity and are inert. The viewport's edges crop the outermost panels. In the gap to the right of the centred panel, top-aligned with it, a 24ch column gives its name at 24px in a light weight and two lines at 16px in a lifted ink; this text changes as panels arrive. There is no heading above the row.
sections.mobile: The row is 62svh tall; panels snap one per screen at true size, capped at 86vw wide, with neighbours showing 7vw at each side at 22% opacity. The name and its two lines sit beneath the row on the left margin and change with the centred panel. Swiping moves the row.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Question index, one answer
sections.blueprint: Questions on the left, one answer on the right, and the answer changes as the reader moves through the questions. Columns 1–5 list all questions at one size, 18px, with 18px between them; each is preceded by a solid dot 8px across, in the softer ink when idle and in the accent colour when selected. The selected question is in the full ink, the rest in the softer ink. Columns 7–12 hold the answer pane, `position: sticky; top: 120px`: the selected answer at 24–28px in the regular weight, leading 1.3, measure about 30ch, so the answer, not the question, is the large type. Selection follows hover, click and keyboard focus; the pane crossfades in 150ms. The first question is selected on load. A two-word heading in the softer ink is the first line of the list, at the same 18px.
sections.mobile: The list runs full width at 18px. Tapping a question colours its dot and opens its answer directly beneath at 19px, indented to line up with the question text; other answers close. There is no pane and no sticky element.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: Gil Huybrecht
references.idea: A portfolio as a contact sheet: every project is a numbered run of miniature page screenshots on black, and all text is set at one small size.
references.hero: Black field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins. The top band is plain white text at one size, about 16px: name in column one, availability in column two, a services list from column three, a longer awards list from column five, then 'Profile' and 'Email me' at the right. List items are indented one step under their label. Below the lists roughly 300px of black is left empty. At mid-height the thumbnail grid begins: one small website screenshot per column, about 190px wide, each topped by a number at its right corner, with the project name over the first of each run. Two tiny toggle chips sit in the bottom corners.
references.type: One neo-grotesk at a single size, about 16px (1.1vw), medium-bold with tight tracking, white on black, for everything: name, lists, labels, numbers, footer. There is no headline; hierarchy comes only from column position and indentation.
references.colour: #000000 #fcfcfc #272727 #8a8a8a — Pure black with white text; the only colour is whatever appears inside the screenshot thumbnails. Inactive toggle words drop to mid-grey on a dark grey chip.
references.imagery: Miniature full-page captures of the designer's client sites, uncropped at natural aspect ratios, square corners, no frames or shadows, about 190px wide, sitting directly on black.
references.layout: Seven equal columns with 14px gutters and margins for the whole page. Thumbnails align to columns but not to rows: each hangs from its own label at its own height, so bottoms are ragged. Projects flow continuously and wrap across rows.

sections.description: A seven-column field of screenshot thumbnails on black. Each project is a consecutive run of four to six thumbnails; the project name sits above the first, and every thumbnail carries its sequence number right-aligned above it in the same 16px white. Thumbnails keep their real proportions, so a row mixes 100px-tall and 280px-tall items with ragged bottoms and about 90px of black between rows. Runs break mid-row and continue on the next line with no divider.

View toggles. Two fixed chip pairs sit in the viewport's bottom corners: the left switches between a grid and a gallery view, the right between a normal and a novelty perspective mode. Each pair is a small dark-grey rounded rectangle containing two words, the active one white and the inactive grey, at the same 16px as all other text.

After about a screen of empty black, one band of text on the same seven columns: year and privacy link stacked at the left, then two columns of stacked social links, then two single links toward the right edge. Same size and weight as the header, no rule, no logo.

steal: Set every piece of text on the page at one size and weight and build hierarchy only from column position and a one-step indent under labels.
Show projects as numbered runs of uncropped page screenshots at natural heights on a strict column grid, leaving the bottoms ragged.
Leave a deliberate 300px void between the text header and the first row of work so the lists read as a letterhead.

references.name: Plastic
references.idea: A plain, quiet app page given one physical object: a photographed vinyl record cropped by the top-right corner of the viewport.
references.hero: Pale grey page with no navigation, only a bold wordmark with a small orange-red caps descriptor beneath it at top left (80px margin). A photographed black vinyl record with an orange-red label is cropped by the top-right corner, showing a quarter disc about 360px wide and tall, with an orange wire stand poking out below it. The headline is centred slightly above the middle in two lines at 74px (5.2vw), about 37% of the viewport wide, followed by a two-line 17px sentence and two black store badges side by side. Lower down, an award mark and a laurel-framed rating sit centred; the bottom fifth is empty.
references.type: Archivo only. Headline weight 500, sentence case, tight leading, 74px against 17px body, about a 4.4x jump. Feature headings near 30px in two colours, a much larger heading in the dark section (digest peak 12vw), and tiny tracked caps in the footer.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #d5d5d5 #090d0e #171615 #e0441c — Greys and near-black with one orange-red accent taken from the record label; it colours the logo descriptor and the first line of each feature heading. One near-black section breaks the light page.
references.imagery: Phone mockups with real app screens (album-cover grids, a camera view) sit inside mid-grey rounded panels and are cropped by the panel edge. The hero uses a cut-out photographed record with a soft shadow; album art supplies the colour.
references.layout: Centred hero, then feature rows on a wide container: a tall grey panel on one side and a short text block vertically centred on the other, sides swapping per row. A dark full-width section with offset white cards follows, then a narrow FAQ column and a sparse footer.

sections.description: Each feature is a two-column row. One column is a mid-grey rounded panel about 540px wide and 720px tall containing a phone mockup pinned near the top, with the next phone's top edge peeking in at the panel's bottom. The other column holds a two-line heading, first line orange-red and second near-black at the same size, over a three-line grey paragraph, vertically centred. The panel side alternates left and right.

A near-black full-width section opens with a large centred white heading. Below it, white rounded cards of different sizes are placed off-grid at staggered horizontal positions: one holds an album-cover collage with a record sliding out, with a bold white caption and a grey line beneath it on the dark ground; another is a small data card listing collection fields as label and value rows.

A left-aligned column about 480px wide, offset toward the page centre and headed by a bold short title. Six questions in small bold text are separated by hairlines, each with a plus sign at the right edge. A generous empty gap follows before a footer of three tiny caps link groups spread left, centre and right, small legal notes, and a pipe-separated caps link row.

steal: Crop one photographed physical object by a viewport corner so the hero has a subject without a centred mockup.
Set two-line feature headings at one size with the first line in the accent colour and the second in ink.
Drop the nav entirely on a one-page app site: wordmark plus a one-line descriptor top left, store badges directly under the headline.

references.name: Butter
references.idea: A video editor presented as a bunch of collectable objects: 3D keychain charms in the hero and squircle effect tiles that behave like app icons everywhere else.
references.hero: Soft grey vertical gradient, darker at the top, fading to near-white. Two floating light-grey rounded capsules form the nav: the left holds the script logo, five links and a kebab; the right holds Login and a black button. A 3D bunch of keychain charms (orange carabiner, black letter keycap, chrome ring, magenta disc, steel key, green script tag) hangs from the top edge at centre, overlapping the nav and stopping just above the headline. The headline is one centred line at 7.5vw in regular-weight grotesk spanning 75% of the width, with a 24px sub-line and a black rounded-rectangle button beneath. The bottom 35% is empty.
references.type: DieGrotesk regular at 107px for the one-line headline, near-zero tracking, mixed case; the same face at 24px and 16px below, so a 4.5x then 1.5x step. ABC Diatype for tiny labels inside product panels. The logo is brush-script lettering used as an image.
references.colour: #e8e8e8 #f5f5f5 #1e1e1e #0a0909 #ff3fd8 #19e319 — Grey-to-white ground with black type and black product panels. Saturated colour (magenta, green, orange, holographic pastels) appears only on 3D objects, effect tiles and the footer wordmark.
references.imagery: Live 3D charms with chrome and plastic materials; black editor UI panels with 24px radius; many small squircle video tiles showing halftone, glitch and type-poster effects; a full-width extruded script wordmark.
references.layout: 96px side margins for the nav capsules, a centred content column and very large vertical gaps between blocks. Light grey throughout, with black product panels sliding in from below; ends on a full-bleed wordmark.

sections.description: A single row of seven client logos in black spans the full width, then a long gap, then a centred three-line statement at about 32px, roughly 580px wide, with five small squircle thumbnails (app-icon sized, each a different texture or brand tile) set inline between words like emoji. Words resolve from blurred pale grey to sharp black with scroll, so the last line is still soft and tinted.

A black rounded panel about 690px wide slides up from below: a timeline with timecode, ruler ticks and a track of squircle clips, each clip a vivid texture (halftone horse, glitch stripes, red type poster). One clip is lifted out of the track, enlarged and rotated a few degrees, overlapping the panel's top edge. A second black panel shows a labelled library grid of the same tiles.

Text link columns sit at the top; below them the script wordmark is blown up to the full width and cropped by the bottom edge, drawn in solid black with a thick extruded underside in a holographic pink, blue and cyan gradient and a registered mark at its top right.

steal: Hang a cluster of 3D branded charms from the top edge so it overlaps the nav and points down at a one-line headline.
Set small squircle thumbnails inline between the words of a statement and resolve the words from blurred to sharp on scroll.
End on the script wordmark at full width with a holographic extruded underside, cropped by the bottom edge.
